title: The /join first question shows the six doors
detail: On the Frequency design the /join 'who are you' cards are the six operator doors (Coaches and guides, Studios and instructors, Event hosts, Venues, Nonprofits, Networks) plus 'Just here to belong', from DOOR_CHOICES in lib/onboarding/personas.ts. Each door maps to an existing persona, so the stored persona, tag, tour reel and Vera are unchanged. DAWN keeps the four-persona picker.
